title: Beluga | Gulf Front Seaside Retreat | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Beluga is a timeless Seaside retreat just steps from the beach, featuring panoramic Gulf views, balconies, Viking kitchen, bikes, and resort amenities.
description_expanded: Beluga Features - Panoramic Gulf Views from 2nd and 3rd Floor Balconies - 20 yards to Seaside Beach Pavilion at Ruskin St - Enjoy 5 Taxi bikes, serviced regularly to keep them in top shape - Outdoor dining and sitting area on 3rd floor Gulf facing balcony - Incredible Primary King Suite with Gulf Views plus TWO ensuite baths. No sharing needed! - Private 2nd floor Gulf facing balcony with daybed swing for the Primary King Suite - Private elevator travels to all floors. Adult use only. Please ask for details regarding mobility considerations for anyone in your group. - Footsteps to Seaside Commercial District - 1 min walk to Bud and Alleys! -Access to all Seaside Community Pools and Fitness Center included with your reservation. Schedule tennis lessons or rent court time on the Pickleball Courts -Access to Seaside Beach private entrances and all Seaside community pools included with your reservation. Some pools heated during cooler months. Towel service available; subject to change by the HOA. - Gourmet kitchen with Viking appliances - Highchair and pack-n-play available - Outdoor propane grill on ground level - 3rd Floor powder room - 3rd Floor main living room with Panoramic Gulf views (fireplace is decorative and not available for use) - 3rd floor Dining area - 1st floor entry foyer with library, table for 4, and TV - 2nd floor sitting room with TV - TVs throughout home including Smart TV in living room - Cable and WIFI - Washer and Dryer on 1st floor - Carport parking for 2 vehicles - Access to private Seaside Beach gates, community pools, and Seaside Fitness included with your reservation. Seaside Pools heated in cooler months (subject to change by the HOA) - Golf cart rentals restricted in Seaside per the HOA (Medical exceptions may be granted on a limited basis) - Concierge services including beach chair rentals, baby equipment rentals, grocery delivery, luxury yacht charters and private chefs available. - Area summer camps and kids' classes available - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee Step into a timeless coastal retreat where vintage charm meets relaxed sophistication. Perfectly perched in the heart of Seaside, Beluga offers an unparalleled location-just 20 yards from the iconic Ruskin Street Beach Pavilion-and sweeping Gulf views from its 2nd and 3rd floor balconies. Here, every detail is designed for effortless living by the shore. Inside, warm wood tones, curated coastal décor, and soft, sun-washed textures create a sense of nostalgic elegance. The showpiece Primary King Suite spans the 2nd floor with two private ensuite baths (no sharing required), a spacious Gulf-facing balcony, and a charming daybed swing to relax away the afternoons. Gather on the 3rd floor where the gourmet Viking kitchen, dining area, and airy main living room open onto a grand Gulf-view balcony-perfect for sunset dinners or lingering with morning coffee. A private elevator (adult use only) connects all levels, making access easy for everyone. Five beautifully appointed suites-three with king beds and two bunk suites-offer space for up to 18 guests, blending comfort with coastal character. After a sun-kissed day, enjoy the Seaside lifestyle at your doorstep: stroll to Bud & Alley's in a minute, browse boutique shops, or take in a concert on the green. Beluga includes exclusive access to Seaside's private beach gates, community pools (heated seasonally), and fitness center. Five vintage-style taxi bikes are ready for a breezy ride through town, and concierge services are available to add even more ease to your stay. This is Seaside living at its most iconic-where Gulf breezes mingle with timeless style, and every day feels like it belongs to another, slower era.
rooms_guidance: 2nd Floor King Suite 1 | TV, TWO ensuite baths with private walk-in shower and separate combination shower/tub, private vanity area, spacious private Gulf Facing balcony with daybed swing
1st Floor King Suite 2 | TV, Tempur-Pedic Mattress, ensuite bath with combination shower/tub
1st Floor King Suite 3 | TV, Tempur-Pedic Mattress, TV, ensuite bath with combination shower/tub

1st Floor Bunk Suite 1 | Sleeping for 6 in two Twin over Queen Bunks, TV, ensuite Full bath with walk-in shower. Exterior entrance to full bath also available. Walk from the beach directly into the bathroom!
1st Floor Bunk Suite 2 | Sleeping for 6 in two Twin over Queen Bunks, TV, ensuite Full bath with walk-in shower

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
Property Amenities: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
